Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts (2310.02255v1) · paper method: MathVista uses heuristic filtering of nineteen VQA datasets followed by three expert annotators and majority voting to identify mathematical-reasoning examples, capping each source at 400 examples.

MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts (2310.02255v1) · paper method: MathVista uses an LLM-based answer extractor such as GPT-4, normalizes the extracted answer into the required format, and computes accuracy against reference answers.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MathVista: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts (2310.02255v1) · paper method: Each MathVista testmini question is assigned to five AMT annotators with over 5,000 HITs and acceptance above 0.99; included workers must pass qualification questions and have at least a high-school diploma.
